decisive_items: Peritoneal biopsy showed dense atypical lymphoid infiltrate involving adipose tissue lobules
Immunohistochemistry: Positive for CD3, CD8, CD7, CD43, CD5 (partial loss), TIA-1, granzyme B, CD2, and TCRβ F1; negative for TCRδ
response.rationale: T-cell lymphoma is the primary diagnosis supported by the atypical T-cell infiltration on biopsy and the cytotoxic T-cell immunophenotype. HLH is present as a secondary complication rather than the underlying disease.

rejected.why: HLH findings are secondary manifestations and do not account for the definitive atypical T-cell infiltrate.
